metadata.value: This repository contains the code for out of the box ready to use zero-shot classifiers among different tasks, such as Topic Labelling or Relation Extraction. It is built on top of 🤗 HuggingFace Transformers library, so you are free to choose among hundreds of models. You can either, use a dataset specific classifier or define one yourself with just labels descriptions or templates!
